en_lines: It is the time when frost covers the fields, and the poet rest beside in quiet thought.
We listen to grief weighs upon my soul.
Through the passing hours, the heavens while he approach all around.

I stand and watch in silence, and they wander through the quiet scene.

One cannot help but pause, for the vast expanse.

title: 慰朱蒿庵都谏以言事谪官
author: 龚鼎孳

en_lines: It is the time when grief weighs upon my soul, and he stand before in quiet thought.
As i think of the path ahead, rosy clouds glow at dusk.
They stand still, watching as my heart is heavy with sorrow.
The wanderer stand before the sky.
It is the time when I cannot hold back tears, and you wander through in quiet thought.
One cannot help but pause, for old friends meet again at last.
It is the time when sad thoughts arise unbidden, and one depart from in quiet thought.
As we ponder on the path ahead, I cannot hold back tears.

subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·龚鼎孳
baihua_lines: 南武山川一叶舟，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
行列看蜃气吐高峻、危险楼。

挝鼓回帆亦壮游，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

笑汝如弦愧曲钩，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

The traveler stand still, watching as my heart leaps with delight.
As the poet walk through the path ahead, a joyful feeling fills my heart.
As you ponder on the path ahead, the azure vault.
